subGoals.rule: Splitting a lot changes and stores one SeedLot instance; the new lot at the receiving garden is created from a stored event, not stored by the same command (Vernon P4).
The quarantine period and the germination floor are invariants of the lot and are enforced inside SeedLot, not in a service, the store or the composition root (Vernon P4).

precedent: clean only: the lot shelf keeps a lot together with its unsent events in one step (keep), and a courier passes them on after each request (thank-you note on lot-donated).
